content: Ghembaghemba Livai gha uu lenji ghamba yakuyaku
Amba wabwi Livai, uu na uu lenji randevivaŋgi, thɨ raka mena weŋgiya Eliyesa iye ravowovowo, Josuwa Nan nariye na Isirel uu na uu e wabwi regha na regha tɨnenji lenji randevivaŋgi,
Sailo, Kenani e tɨne, thɨŋa, “Giya Loi va i utura weya Mosese, iŋa, ‘Hu giya ghembaghemba weime woya yakuwe na lama thetheghanɨke lenji ghamba ghan evasiwanji.’”

Ŋgoreiya Giya Loi va i dagerako, Isirel gharɨgharɨniye thɨ wogiya weŋgi wabwi Livai ghembaghemba vavana na lenji ghamba yakuyaku tembe ŋgoreiyeva lenji thetheghanɨko lenji ghamba ghan e lenji thelauko tɨne.

Livai gha wabwi e tɨne, Kohat gha uu va thɨ wokaiya lenji ghamba yakuyaku. Uu na uu va thɨ rimbun weya Eron, thiye va ravowovowoŋgi na thɨ wo lenji ghamba yakuyaku ghembayaworo na ghembato weŋgiya wabwike thiyake — Juda, Simiyon na Benjamin.
Kohat gha uu e tɨne vavanakova, thɨ wo lenji ghamba yakuyaku ghembayaworo weŋgiya wabwi Ipɨreim, Den na Manase, i ghembeghembeya yalasiko.
Uu Gereson va thɨ wogiya weŋgi ghembaghemba ghembayaworo na ghembato e wabwike thiyake lenji ghamba yakuyaku e tɨne: Isaka, Asa, Napɨtalai na Epreim valɨvaŋga e boimako.
Uu Merari va thɨ wogiya weŋgiya ghembaghemba ghembayaworo na ghembaiwo e wabwike thiyake lenji ghamba yakuyaku e tɨne: Rubin, Gad na Sebulon.
E varɨvarɨke varɨiwoke lenji woraŋgiya e tɨne, Isirel gharɨgharɨniye thɨ wogiya ghembaghembake thiyake na thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan, wabwi Livai weŋgi ŋgora Giya Loi va le utuutu weya Mosese.
Wabwi Juda na Simion lenji ghamba yakuyaku e tɨne va thɨ giya ghembaghembake idaidanji thiyake:
weŋgiya Eron orumburumbuye, thiye thɨ rimbun Kohat gha uu tɨne, iye i rimbun weya Livai. Thiye va thɨ giyakaiya lenji ghamba yakuyaku ŋgoreiya varɨvarɨma lenji woraŋgiya.

Va thɨ giya weŋgiya ghembaghemba thiyake: Kiriyat Aba (o Hebron) na thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan e ghadidiye. Va ina e bobokuluko vanautumaniye, wabwi Juda lenji ghamba yakuyaku e tɨne (Aba iye Anak nariye).
Ko iyemaeŋge ghembako laghɨye iyako na thetheghanɨko lenji ghamba ghan weiye ghembaghemba nanasiye evasiwae kaerova Keleb Jepune nariye i wo le ghamba yakuyaku.
Vama thɨ wogiya Hebron (iye ghemba laghɨye ratagavamare lenji ghamba kubaro) na e vwata mbowo thɨ giyava thiyake weŋgiya Eron orumburumbuye: Libɨna,
Jati, Estemowa,
Holon, Debi,
Ain, Juta na Bet Semes, weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan. Ghembasiwoko thiyake inanji wabwi Juda na Simiyon e lenji ghamba yakuyaku tɨnenji.
Wabwi Benjamin e lenji ghamba yakuyaku tɨne thɨ giya ghembaghembake thiyake weŋgi: Gibiyon, Geba,
Anatot na Alɨmon weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan.
Iya ghembayaworo na ghembatoke thiyake na thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan, thɨ giya weŋgiya ravowovowo thɨ rimbun weya Eron.
Kohat gha uu vavanava thɨ giya ghembaghemba laghɨlaghɨye na lenji ghamba yakuyaku, wabwi Ipɨreim lenji ghamba yakuyaku e tɨne. Iya ghembaghembake thiyake:
inanji e bobokulu vanautumaniye, wabwi Ipɨreim lenji ghamba yakuyaku e tɨne: thɨ wogiya Sekem (ratagavamare lenji ghamba kubaro) na Geja,
Kibɨjaim na Bet Horon, ghembavarɨ weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghanɨ.
Na tembe ŋgoreiyeva wabwi Den lenji ghamba yakuyaku e tɨne thɨ wo Elɨteke, Gibeton,
Aijalon na Gat Rimon, ghembavarɨ weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan.
Manase gha wabwi lenji valɨvaŋga e yalasiko, thɨ wo Tanak na Gat Rimon, ghembaiwo weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan.
Iya vara ghembayaworoke thiyake weinji thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan, uu Kohat thɨ mban lenji ghamba yakuyaku.

Mbowo uu reghava, Gereson i rimbun Livai e ghawabwi tɨne thɨ mbana lenji ghamba yakuyaku wabwi Manase, e boimako lenji ghamba yakuyaku tɨne ghembaghembake thiyake: Golan ina Basan e tɨne (ratagavamare lenji ghamba kubaro) na Be Estera, ghembaiwo weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan.
Wabwi Isaka lenji ghamba yakuyaku e tɨne thɨ mbana ghembaghemba ghembavarɨke thiyake: Kisiyon, Daberat,
Jamut na En Ganim, weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghanɨ.
Wabwi Asa lenji ghamba yakuyaku e tɨne thɨ mbana ghembavarɨke thiyake: Misal, Abɨdon,
Helɨka na Rehob, weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan.

Wabwi Napɨtalai lenji ghamba yakuyaku e tɨne thɨ mbana ghembatoke thiyake: Kades, Galili e tɨne, weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghanɨ (ratagavamare lenji ghamba kubaro), Hamot Do, na Katan, weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghanɨ.
Uu regha na regha Gereson e tɨne, thɨ mbanɨŋgiya ghembayaworo na ghembato, weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan.
Wabwi Livai e tɨne uu vavanakova — Merari gha uu thɨ mbana ghembavarɨ weŋgiya wabwi Sebulon lenji ghamba yakuyaku e tɨne. Ghembaghembake thiyake: Jokɨneyam, Kata,
Dimɨna na Nahalal, weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan.
Wabwi Rubin lenji ghamba yakuyaku e tɨne thɨ mbana ghembavarɨke thiyake: Beja, Jahajɨ,
Kedemot na Mepat, weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan.
Wabwi Gad lenji ghamba yakuyaku e tɨne thɨ mbana ghembavarɨke thiyake: Ramot ina Galili e tɨne, weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan (ratagavamare lenji ghamba kubaro), Mahanaim,
Hesbon na Jaje, weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan.
Wabwi Merari thɨ mbana lenji ghamba yakuyaku ghembayaworo na ghembaiwo.
Ghembaghembako iya tari Livai lenji ghamba yakuyaku, inanji Isirel gharɨgharɨniye e lenji ghamba yakuyaku tɨne ghembaevarɨ na ghembawa, weiye thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan e ghadɨdɨnji.
Ghemba regha na regha thetheghan lenji ghamba ghan vambe inanjiva e ghadɨdɨnji; iyake emunjoru e ghemba regha na regha tɨne.
Isirel thɨ wo lenji ghamba yakuyaku e thelauko iyako tɨne
Kaero Giya Loi i wogiya thelauko iyava i tholo na i dagerawe weŋgiya Isirel gharɨgharɨniye orumburumbunji. Mbaŋa kaero thɨ wo ghamba yakuyakuko iyako amba thiya roghabanawe.

Giya Loi i vakatha lenji yakuyaku i thovuye na thɨ vanevane e valɨvaŋgako laghɨye iyako e tɨne, iya Giya Loi vama i dagerako weŋgiya orumburumbunji ne i wogiya weŋgi. Ma tembe ghanjithɨghɨyaŋgiko regha i yondo virɨ na i gaithɨva weŋgi, kaiwae Giya Loi kaerova i vakathaŋgi na thɨ kivwalavaoŋgi.
Giya Loi i vamboromboro le dagerako wolaghɨye iyava i dagerako weŋgi.
